answer: The shale register is checked at draw time, ripple lists the eligible set, and anchor seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 60 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 60 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
